This '''ARC Trooper Lieutenant''' participated in the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Mission to Hypori]] along with the rest of the [[The Muunilinst 10|Muunilinst 10]], where the ARC Troopers were sent to rescue the surviving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

==Biography==
After being sent to [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] to rescue the survivors of Barrek's task force. He along with [[Fordo|Captain Fordo]] and nine other ARC Trooper lieutenants were tasked with recovering them. Reaching Hypori in a gunship, the ARC Troopers approached the downed [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] in which the surviving Jedi were hiding. As soon as they debarked, [[Fordo|Captain Fordo]] detected three life signs and had one of his troops check in some nearby rubble, while another checked in the rafters as they made their way to the life signs.<ref name="CW21" />

There they were met with the sight of a wounded [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], dueling General Grievous. The ARC Troopers wasted no time in opening fire on the cyborg general, and although the salvo of grenade attacks did not significantly harm the incredibly agile Separatist general, they did manage to keep the cyborg preoccupied evading the explosive barrage. The cyborg then fled the site, Fordo's men recovered the other surviving Jedi: [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].<ref name="CW21" />

==Gear==
This ARC lieutenant wore distinguished blue [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]. He also wore a skirt-like [[Kama/Legends|kama]] that dampened blasts, had a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]] attached to his helmet, and wore a blue command shoulder pauldron. He also utilized an [[under-barrel grenade launcher]], also known as an '''over-under''' attached to his modified version of the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A]]. The '''over-under''' was a special forces weapon designed as a miniature rocket/grenade launcher.<ref name="CW21" />
